'''Pine Cones''' are dropped by cutting down [[Pine]]s. They can be planted using the [[Cultivator]] to produce Pine trees. Once planted, the cones take a few in-game days to grow to full size. Tree saplings require a fair amount of space directly around from where they are planted. Without it, they will not grow into trees.

{{infobox character | name = Hildir | image = Hildir Definitive.png | caption = | id = Hildir | aliases = | affiliation = | marital = | birthDate = | birthPlace = | deathDate = | deathPlace = | species = Dvergr | gender = Female | height = | weight = | eyes = Light blue |Release Ver.=[[Version history#0.217.14_-_Hildir's_Request|0.217.4]]}} '''Hildir''' is a [[Creatures#NPCs|character]] found in [[Meadows]]. Like her brother, [[Haldor]], she is a [[Dvergr (race)|Dvergr]]. She wears a red and white dress, a green and red necklace and a headband. At her camp, which was recently raided, Hildir sells several unique items that can be purchased for [[Coins]]. ==Biography== ''Hildir'' also speaks, like [[Haldor]], saying sentences like, "My wares are made out of the finest cloth," and "You'll only find products of the finest quality in my shop, I assure you." She has two [[Lox]], named [[Blåbär]] and [[Hallon]]. ==Location== [[File:Hildur's Camp Screenshot.jpg|thumb|right|300px]]Hildir has a similar spawning system to Haldor with 10 possible spawn locations that are located in [[Meadows]], each at least 1000 meters apart, and only found between 3000 and 5100 metersThe game will actually attempt to spawn Hildir between 3000 and 8000 meters from the center of the world. However, Meadows biomes only extend up to 5100 meters, which reduces the viable range down to 3000 - 5100 meters. from the world center. Approaching any of these locations will permanently place Hildir there. When discovered, her dress icon will appear on the world map. She spawns with her own [[Points of Interest (POI)|point of interest]], a small camp consisting of a large wagon, with multiple tents, barrels, her own [[Iron Fire Pit]], and multiple divans the player can sit on, and tables. Like the other traders, the camp is surrounded by a shimmering transparent dome that acts as a safety zone that [[Creatures]] cannot enter. The safe zone cannot be destroyed. ==Quests== Hildir has a map table in front of her that leads to various different locations where special dungeons with special minibosses can be fought, and different loot is found. Interacting with the table adds the locations to the player's map. The locations are: * [[Smouldering Tomb]] in [[Black Forest]] * [[Howling Cavern]] in [[Mountains]] * [[Sealed Tower]] in [[Plains]] Up to three of each type of these locations will generate in each world. The spawning rules for each location type are as follows: * Smouldering Tombs: Each 3000 meters apart, between 3000 - 8000 meters from the world center, at an altitude of at least 1 meter. * Howling Caverns: Each 2000 meters apart, between 1000 - 8000 meters from the world center, at an altitude of at least 200 meters. * Sealed Tower: Each 3000 meters apart, at an altitude of at least 8 meters. When players find Hildir, it can be a good idea to drop a [[Portal]] in the vicinity to make easier returns. Each of these quest locations is full of loot, enemies, and unique minibosses. Once defeated, these minibosses each drop a quest item: * {{Item Link|Hildir's brass chest|size=64px}}, dropped by [[Brenna]] in the [[Smouldering Tomb]] * {{Item Link|Hildir's silver chest|size=64px}}, dropped by [[Geirrhafa]] in the [[Howling Cavern]] * {{Item Link|Hildir's bronze chest|size=64px}}, dropped by [[Zil]] of [[Zil & Thungr]] in the [[Sealed Tower]] Each of these chests weighs 200.0, has a stack size of 1, and '''cannot be teleported''' via [[Portal]]. They can, however, be teleported with a [[Portal stone]]. Chests can be returned to Hildir, which unlocks additional trades from her; note that only one of each type of chest can be returned. Defeating one of these minibosses will enable new [[Events]], which will cause that boss and their minions to invade the player's base.
